scope.reads: Frozen manifest and prior audit/report/source code; byte-prefix-filtered test/OOD case/family sidecars and test/OOD typed records only.
scope.purpose: Document task structure, fixed reference populations and future scoring boundaries. No predictions, model performance or evaluator behavior are measured.

reusable_independent_helpers.arithmetic: Independent exact integer cents, not producer Decimal normalization.
reusable_independent_helpers.warning: Do not invoke verify(directory) for heldout-only work: that function reads every split's targets.

prior_frozen_audit.scope: Previously completed full-corpus audit; reused as frozen evidence without rerunning it.
prior_frozen_audit.previous_tests: reports/amount-extraction-control-v1/test-verification.json records 21 passed tests from the earlier authorized audit. They were not rerun in this review.

heads.span: Choice over every actual regex candidate plus none
heads.target_present: Noul; populated requested-role field presence independent of recall

A.expected: A unique requested-role field must exactly match candidate text and both Python character offsets. none can mean absent, ambiguous or candidate miss.

B.availability: A B request exists for every actual regex candidate, including wrong-role, repeated-value and partial candidates. Runtime B must be constructed from the actual A selection; none/A failure sends no B.
B.is_credit: The wire request always contains all three heads. is_credit reference is a boolean only when reference direction_known is true; otherwise it is null and its typed supervision row is absent.

normalization.exactness: amount is an exact decimal string with two fractional digits. Copy sign once according to credit flow; do not convert to float, round, or use finite-context arithmetic to compare long exact amounts.
normalization.refusal: Partial/unbound source span, invalid grammar, unsupported/mismatched currency, unknown/conflicting direction or mismatched credit decision returns review with currency=null and amount=null. These nulls never establish extraction success.

scoring_boundaries: Use all unique-present targets for exact raw-span, final currency/amount and complete-output denominators: test 168, OOD 480, total 648. Candidate misses, unknown attributes and failed/skipped stages remain in these populations.

The fixed reference-ready subset is the requested unique target actually recalled as a B candidate whose independently reconstructed normalized_reference is ready: test 84, OOD 240, total 324. A/B failures, wrong A selections and missing outputs remain zero in that fixed subset. Do not construct an oracle B on an unrecalled target to enlarge availability.
A candidate miss with reference none may earn raw span Choice credit, but actual extraction is zero. Returning none with high target_present is permitted on a miss.

A wrong-role or wrong-offset complete candidate may normalize to ready and may receive correct B attribute scores, but requested-target end-to-end success stays zero. Match original text, start and end, currency, and exact signed amount.
Score B currency and direction_known against the reference for the actual A-selected candidate. Do not use the requested target's reference to repair A or replace the B input.

For raw conditional is_credit accuracy, include actual A-selected candidates whose reference direction_known is true, including failed B responses. Never use predicted direction_known, predicted is_credit, currency readiness or guard acceptance to shrink this denominator.

When actual-candidate reference direction_known is false, is_credit is semantically undefined. Do not coerce null to false, add false supervision, award free correctness, or penalize a particular valid credit probability. Direction-known and any explicit joint-decision metric handle the known/unknown decision separately.

Undefined semantic is_credit does not waive the declared HTTP schema: B still requests all three typed heads, so their response probabilities must remain valid if strict response validation is used. Ignoring a semantic target is distinct from accepting malformed responses.

Currency review does not imply unknown direction: heldout data includes 54 actual candidates (test 14, OOD 40), all also requested recalled targets, with currency review but defined is_credit. Keep them in reference-known credit scoring even though they cannot become ready amounts.

Presence is an independent A metric and should not gate a valid actual non-none B. A complete-output metric can additionally require positive presence; final-value success alone should not silently inherit that gate.
Correct review of an unknown/conflicting/partial candidate is a guard or decision result, not amount extraction success. Never allow amount=None and expected amount=None to count as a match.
All-candidate B counts are useful frozen coverage evidence, not the runtime B denominator: a model invokes B only for its actual valid non-none A choices.
verification_limits: Heldout A/B sidecar semantics and normalized references were reconstructed using the previously audited independent helper.

Typed heldout checks verify exact row-ID coverage for defined references, head counts, omission of undefined is_credit, and normalized target-vector shape. This review did not recompile and compare every typed target bit; the pinned prior full audit already covers that and the parent is implementing a dedicated heldout preflight.
No family sampling or example filtering was performed for these aggregate counts.
No draft amount corpus was read or used.

runs/phone-extraction-control-v1-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys

root = Path.cwd()
data = root / "data/amount-extraction-control-v1"
audit_path = root / "reports/amount-extraction-control-v1/independent-audit.json"
helper_path = root / "reports/amount-extraction-control-v1/verify.py"
def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1048576), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()
pins = {
    "data/amount-extraction-control-v1/manifest.json": "6f89f81336ac36505c563193da27fca2155fa566175451854f0ac410979ea80b",
    "reports/amount-extraction-control-v1/independent-audit.json": "ed9f0aaf9f1c40fde1379d4655f40b1199b621ea204cc853b00fec2581fd2e22",
    "reports/amount-extraction-control-v1/verify.py": "dc4727e62791af8b8ac2776358868c2f1f6ed810387ecae00e6d5087e39aef24",
}
assert all(sha(root / name) == digest for name, digest in pins.items())
manifest = json.loads((data / "manifest.json").read_bytes())
assert all(sha(data / name) == digest for name, digest in manifest["files_sha256"].items())
assert all(sha(root / "jev" / name) == digest for name, digest in manifest["configuration"]["source_files_sha256"].items())
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("reviewed_amount_reference_helpers", helper_path)
helper = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
identifier = rb"[A-Za-z0-9:_-]+"
prefixes = {
    "cases": re.compile(rb'\A\{"id":"(?P<id>' + identifier + rb')","family_id":"(?P<family_id>' + identifier + rb')","group_id":"(?P<group_id>' + identifier + rb')","split":"(?P<split>train|calibration|validation|test|ood)",'),
    "families": re.compile(rb'\A\{"id":"(?P<id>' + identifier + rb')","group_id":"(?P<group_id>' + identifier + rb')","split":"(?P<split>train|calibration|validation|test|ood)",'),
}
decode_logs = {}
def heldout(kind):
    selected, prefix_counts, decoded_counts = [], Counter(), Counter()
    with (data / (kind + ".jsonl")).open("rb") as stream:
        for raw in stream:
            if not raw.strip():
                continue
            match = prefixes[kind].match(raw[:512])
            assert match is not None, "Unexpected metadata prefix; no fallback to JSON decoding"
            meta = {key: value.decode("ascii") for key, value in match.groupdict().items()}
            split = meta["split"]
            prefix_counts[split] += 1
            if split not in ("test", "ood"):
                continue
            record = json.loads(raw)
            decoded_counts[split] += 1
            assert all(record[key] == value for key, value in meta.items())
            selected.append(record)
    decode_logs[kind] = {
        "prefix_counts": {split: prefix_counts[split] for split in helper.SPLITS},
        "full_payload_decode_counts": {split: decoded_counts[split] for split in helper.SPLITS},
    }
    return selected

cases = heldout("cases")
families = heldout("families")
family_by_id = {family["id"]: family for family in families}
stats = {}
for split in ("test", "ood"):
    selected = [case for case in cases if case["split"] == split]
    count, heads, normalized_reasons, omits = Counter(), Counter(), Counter(), Counter()
    expected_rows = {}
    for case in selected:
        family = family_by_id[case["family_id"]]
        assert case["id"] in family["case_ids"]
        assert all(case[key] == family[key] for key in ("group_id", "split", "template_id"))
        request = case["selection_request"]
        reference = helper.selection(request["state"])
        assert reference == case["selection_reference"]
        count["a_" + reference["reason"]] += 1
        candidates = request["state"]["candidates"]
        assert [item["candidate_id"] for item in case["attributes"]] == list(candidates)
        for head in ("span", "target_present"):
            if head == "span" and not candidates:
                continue
            expected_rows[case["id"] + ":selection:request:" + head] = reference[head]
        attr_by_id = {}
        for item in case["attributes"]:
            state = item["request"]["state"]
            assert state == {"text": request["state"]["text"], "policy": request["state"]["policy"],
                             "selected_id": item["candidate_id"], "selected": candidates[item["candidate_id"]]}
            attr = helper.attributes(state)
            assert attr == item["reference"]
            normal = helper.normalized(state, **{key: attr[key] for key in ("currency", "direction_known", "is_credit")})
            assert normal == item["normalized_reference"]
            attr_by_id[item["candidate_id"]] = (attr, normal)
            count["all_B_candidates"] += 1
            count["all_B_direction_known" if attr["direction_known"] else "all_B_direction_unknown"] += 1
            count["all_B_normalization_" + normal["status"]] += 1
            count["all_B_currency_" + attr["currency"]] += 1
            if attr["currency"] == "review" and attr["direction_known"]:
                count["all_B_currency_review_but_credit_defined"] += 1
            if attr["direction_known"]:
                assert type(attr["is_credit"]) is bool
            else:
                assert attr["is_credit"] is None
            for head in ("currency", "direction_known", "is_credit"):
                if attr[head] is None:
                    continue
                expected_rows[case["id"] + ":attributes:" + item["candidate_id"] + ":" + head] = attr[head]
        if reference["reason"] == "recalled":
            attr, normal = attr_by_id[reference["span"]]
            count["unique_recalled_reference_" + normal["status"]] += 1
            count["unique_recalled_direction_known" if attr["direction_known"] else "unique_recalled_direction_unknown"] += 1
            if normal["status"] == "review":
                normalized_reasons[normal["reason"]] += 1
            if attr["currency"] == "review" and attr["direction_known"]:
                count["unique_recalled_currency_review_but_credit_defined"] += 1
        for omission in case["omitted_supervision"]:
            omits[omission["reason"]] += 1
            assert omission["head"] == ("is_credit" if omission["reason"] == "undefined_direction" else "span")
            if omission["reason"] == "undefined_direction":
                assert attr_by_id[omission["candidate_id"]][0]["is_credit"] is None
    parsed_records = []
    with (data / (split + ".jsonl")).open("rb") as stream:
        for raw in stream:
            if raw.strip():
                record = json.loads(raw)
                assert record["split"] == split
                parsed_records.append(record)
    assert len(parsed_records) == manifest["counts"][split] == len(expected_rows)
    assert set(record["id"] for record in parsed_records) == set(expected_rows)
    for record in parsed_records:
        head = record["metadata"]["stage"] + "/" + record["metadata"]["question_id"]
        heads[head] += 1
        assert expected_rows[record["id"]] is not None
        assert len(record["target"]) == len(record["options"])
        assert sum(record["target"]) == 1
    stats[split] = {
        "documents": len(selected), "groups": len({case["group_id"] for case in selected}),
        "typed_records": len(parsed_records), "counts": dict(sorted(count.items())),
        "unique_present": count["a_recalled"] + count["a_candidate_miss"],
        "reference_ready_on_unique_actual_recalled_target": count["unique_recalled_reference_ready"],
        "head_counts": dict(sorted(heads.items())), "omitted_supervision": dict(sorted(omits.items())),
        "unique_recalled_review_reasons": dict(sorted(normalized_reasons.items())),
        "schema": {
            "case_keys": list(selected[0]), "A_state_keys": list(selected[0]["selection_request"]["state"]),
            "A_heads": list(selected[0]["selection_request"]["questions"]),
            "B_sidecar_keys": list(selected[0]["attributes"][0]),
            "B_state_keys": list(selected[0]["attributes"][0]["request"]["state"]),
            "B_heads": list(selected[0]["attributes"][0]["request"]["questions"]),
            "typed_record_keys": list(parsed_records[0]),
        },
    }
assert all(sha(data / name) == digest for name, digest in manifest["files_sha256"].items())
assert "jev.case_amount_extraction" not in sys.modules
print(json.dumps({
    "pins": pins, "source_files_sha256": manifest["configuration"]["source_files_sha256"],
    "dataset_files_sha256": manifest["files_sha256"], "decode_logs": decode_logs, "heldout": stats,
    "full_corpus_verify_called": False, "producer_imported": False, "model_or_http_performed": False,
    "nonheldout_split_files_hashed_without_parsing": ["train.jsonl", "calibration.jsonl", "validation.jsonl"],
}, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
PY
